suggestions.title: Extended Operating Hours
suggestions.description: Extend clinic hours to accommodate working patients by offering evening appointments until 8pm on weekdays.

suggestions.title: Online Prescription Renewal
suggestions.description: Implement a feature in the patient portal that allows patients to request prescription renewals online without calling.

suggestions.title: Multilingual Support
suggestions.description: Add multilingual support for common languages in our community to improve accessibility for non-English speaking patients.

suggestions.title: Virtual Waiting Room
suggestions.description: Implement a virtual waiting room so patients can wait in their cars and receive text notifications when the doctor is ready to see them.
